detail.verdictBasis: Only 7 reverse-order pairs; order and scenario/wave effects cannot be separated reliably. Effect direction was not used.

detail.importantLimitation: No S32-S48 candidate reaches 80% Holm-worst-threshold power for every contrast under the 10% effect planning scenario; C2 is the limiting contrast. This is not a launch recommendation.
rationale: Preserves the complete 74-campaign matrix and multiples-of-four Williams balance.
Uses the largest preregistered shared-primary block count while retaining the minimum preregistered H32 for secondary descriptive heterogeneity.
Its conservative summed-p95 projection remains below the earlier 36-hour planning boundary.
Does not rely on favorable observed pilot effect direction.
Requires the user to choose a practical-effect margin and decide whether a balanced supplemental heterogeneous pilot is needed.
